# ArcGIS fixtures

`acs-ocean-chemistry-variables.xml` is the ISO 19139 export of the
Australian Climate Service's "Ocean chemistry variables" item (a File
Geodatabase in ArcGIS Online group `40a78e66db6944c0aca00fad63a93056`,
shown at https://www.acs.gov.au/search?groupIds=40a78e66db6944c0aca00fad63a93056).

- Source: https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/52cb2b4d300d4bc59d31555ad9e5dc8c/info/metadata/metadata.xml?format=iso19139
- Fetched: 2026-11-20
- SHA-256: `812406264c1ff65bb39a5d5b6c718955dc6b94caf1c653b3aa34f090e5d9b2e1`
- Licence of the described resource: CC BY 4.0, given as a licence name,

ArcGIS writes the export from its own metadata on each request, so a refetch
may differ even if the item has not been edited.
